name: fused_moe_router_tensorcore
description: fused_moe_router_tensorcore(x, router_weight, topk, moe_softcapping, correction_bias=None) -> (topk_weights, topk_ids). This has the same router math as fused_moe_router_cudacore: logits = x.float() @ router_weight.float().T, optional tanh soft-cap when moe_softcapping != 0, optional correction bias, full-expert softmax, descending top-k ids, and top-k weights gathered from the full softmax without renormalization. The tensor-core implementation uses a pure-fp32 FMA tiling path for M <= 8 and a tiled tl.dot GEMM for M > 8, with NVIDIA tf32/tf32x3 or non-NVIDIA ieee precision selection. The documented supported top-k range is topk <= 2, matching the exercised cases. Returns newly allocated float32 topk_weights [B, topk] and int32 topk_ids [B, topk]. No input mutation. Exercised with bfloat16 x/router_weight, E up to 256, optional softcap and bias.
